title: Can Intelligent User Interfaces Engage in Philosophical Discussions? A Longitudinal Study of Philosophers’ Evolving Perceptions
reasoning: The paper benchmarks the performance of LLMs against human philosophers on various philosophical tasks. This evaluation includes a specific focus on ethics and morality, utilizing modules that test concepts like John Rawls's theory of justice and comparing Taoist religious philosophy (wu wei) with Stoicism. Ethics is treated as a primary domain of the evaluation rather than just a side note.
